Richardson Bike Mart Saturday Rides

Richardson, TX · Road

Richardson Bike Mart Saturday Rides is a road group ride in Richardson, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Bike Mart – Richardson (UTD).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @bikemartstores the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Richardson Bike Mart Saturday Rides group ride

Saturday morning rides from the Richardson store, staggered by speed. The fast Tour de McKinney goes at 8:00 (55 to 70 miles, 22+ mph). The Tour de Richardson (20 miles, 14–15 mph) and Tour de Chick-fil-A (14 miles, 10–12 mph) are no-drop with a ride leader. Pick the group that fits.
